LanguageData.Raven_SoulAltar_Core.label: [Raven] Soul Altar Core
LanguageData.Raven_SoulAltar_Core.description:
The core structure of the Raven Golden Crow ascension ritual. It features precise construction, with its surface engraved with star charts and bloodline circuits.

Functions:
- Incubates Raven spirit eggs.
- Links with surrounding infusers and resonance pylons.
- Must be placed in the center of the ritual floor.
LanguageData.Raven_Altar_Infuser.label: [Raven] Infuser
LanguageData.Raven_Altar_Infuser.description: An inner ring component of the altar. Placing specific materials inside can enhance the attributes of the Raven Spirit Egg.
LanguageData.Raven_Altar_Pylon.label: [Raven] Pylon
LanguageData.Raven_Altar_Pylon.description: An outer ring component of the altar. When powered, it accelerates the incubation process.
LanguageData.Raven_Altar_Injector.label: [Raven] Injector
LanguageData.Raven_Altar_Injector.description: An advanced enhancement module for the altar. Used to inject special substances to acquire powerful traits.
